Record Class VisionResult

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
yall.results.VisionResult
Record Components:
cameraName - Name of the camera that produced the frame.
timestampSeconds - When the image was captured, on the Timer.getMonotonicTimestamp() timebase that WPILib's pose estimators use.
latencyMillis - Time from capture to the result reaching the robot, in milliseconds.
targets - Targets in the frame, best first.
public record VisionResult(String cameraName, double timestampSeconds, double latencyMillis, List<VisionTarget> targets) extends Record
One processed camera frame, in the same form for every camera vendor.
